channel.title: NSW Warnings Summary
channel.description: Current warnings for New South Wales. Data © Bureau of Meteorology.

item.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Sydney Metropolitan, Illawarra and parts of the Hunter district
item.description: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall. Locations which may be affected include the Sydney Metropolitan area.

item.title: Severe Weather Warning for parts of Sutherland and the Illawarra
item.description: Damaging winds averaging 60 to 70 km/h are possible. Locations affected include Cronulla and the Sutherland Shire.

item.title: Minor Flood Warning for the Nepean River
item.description: Minor flooding is occurring along the Nepean River.

item.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Penrith and Blacktown
item.description: Severe thunderstorms detected on radar near Penrith and Blacktown.
